description.value: Founded in 1999 with a mission to create a more inclusive surf community, Surf Sister is Tofino's well-known surf school and shop offering lessons, camps, and rentals for all ages and abilities. The main 'Shred Quarters' location sits in downtown Tofino, with a second outpost at Pacific Sands Beach Resort. A repeat Tripadvisor Traveller's Choice Award winner, it draws visitors from around the world to BC's rugged west coast surf scene.
